finding.summary: The bin/pr-review entry point is deleted and the mesh dispatcher (bin/mesh) now only accepts 'review-pull-request' — there is no 'pr-review' case or alias. Any existing callers, scripts, cron jobs, CI configs, or documentation invoking 'mesh pr-review' or 'bin/pr-review' will now fail hard with 'unknown command' or file-not-found, with no deprecation period or pointing error to guide them to the new name.
finding.fix: Add a backward-compatible shim for one release cycle: either a 'pr-review)' case in bin/mesh that prints a deprecation warning to stderr and execs scripts/review-pull-request "$@", or a small bin/pr-review script that warns and forwards to bin/review-pull-request. Remove the shim after callers have migrated.
